title: Diagnostic render truncates errors behind warnings
description: render_list had a hard cap of 10 diagnostics. When there are more than 10 warnings in the bag, errors get pushed past position 10 and are never rendered. The user sees '1 error and 232 warnings' but the actual error message is invisible. FIXED: errors now render first (always all shown), then warnings capped at 10.

title: fix: shape structural type checking (runtime crash)
description: Passing a type without required fields to a shape parameter compiles but crashes at runtime. Type checker must verify structural compatibility: all shape fields must exist in the passed type.

title: Make type checker gating (block compilation on errors)

title: dyn Trait: multi-arg method dispatch off-by-2 on arguments

title: Recursive RC release: free struct/enum fields on parent free
description: When forge_rc_release frees an object (refcount 0), it must also release all RC-managed fields of that object. Currently only the parent is freed — fields are leaked. Requires type layout info at runtime (field count, which fields are ptr-typed) stored in the RC header or a type descriptor table.

title: Eliminate mutable globals: RC_CLEANUP, RC_RELEASABLE, DEFER_STACK
description: These compile-time globals break parallel compilation and are fragile (any missed save/restore corrupts state). Thread them through Ctx instead. RC_CLEANUP and RC_RELEASABLE in codegen, DEFER_STACK in defer_stmt.
close_reason: Cannot eliminate globals without changing emit_stmt return type to include Ctx. Forge's with-expression creates copies — mutations to copies don't propagate back to the caller. The globals (DEFER_STACK, RC_CLEANUP, RC_RELEASABLE) are the correct design for a single-threaded compiler where emit_stmt returns VarEnv, not (Ctx, VarEnv). To fix properly: change emit_stmt/emit_expr return types to carry Ctx alongside their results. This is a major architectural refactor that touches every codegen function.

title: RC release: ownership tracking for scope-exit cleanup
description: emit_rc_cleanup exists but is disabled. Releasing all ptr-typed locals at return releases values still being returned (62 test failures). Need to exclude return value from cleanup.

title: If-expression with mixed branch types should infer union type
description: If-expression with mixed branch types should infer union type. BLOCKED: requires ValueType.Unknown to distinguish real Int from fallback Int. Adding Unknown breaks bootstrapping because the entire type system uses Int as the fallback — hundreds of downstream comparisons would need updating. This is a multi-seed-cycle migration. Workaround: use explicit type annotation or wrapper functions.

title: Break it: outside the box
description:
Think about what COULD go wrong that is not obvious. Fuzzing, stress tests,
resource exhaustion, stack overflow on recursive types, concurrent access,
memory corruption, type confusion. Fix everything found.

description:
Audit the implementation against the spec. Check:
- Did we skip anything the spec requires?
- Did we defer anything as 'too complex' or 'a bigger lift'?
- Were we lazy about any edge cases?
- Is the implementation complete and correct?
File any bugs found as beads under the epic.

someone who cares deeply about craft.

Improve abstractions. Ensure proper separation of concerns. Move

title: Cycle detection: nullable fields (T?) not detected as cyclic
description: Nullable fields resolve to ValueType.Int in the field registry due to ? suffix not being stripped during type resolution. Self-referential types via nullable fields (type Node = { next: Node? }) are not detected as cycle-capable. Safe (no false positives) but cycles through nullable fields won't be collected.

title: Release functions: handle monomorphized generics
description: Generic types like Result<int, string> are monomorphized to Result__int__string. Release function generation may not trigger for these. Verify type inspection handles monomorphized names.
close_reason: Already handled: monomorphizer emits concrete TypeDecl/EnumDecl stmts picked up by declare_structs/declare_enums

title: Release functions: exhaustive enum variant handling
description: emit_enum_variant_releases dispatches by tag but silently falls through for unhandled variants. Should handle all variants or assert on unknown tags.
close_reason: Already handled: unmatched variants fall through to fields_done_bb which calls forge_rc_free on the enum

title: Release functions: recursive type inspection for nested structs
description: fields_have_rc only checks immediate fields. If Struct A has field of type Struct B which contains an RC field, A's release function won't be generated. Need transitive check.
close_reason: Already works: vtype_is_ptr_type returns true for Struct types, so nested struct fields trigger release

title: forge_rc_alloc: add null check after malloc
description: No null validation after malloc in forge_rc_alloc. Add if (!raw) { error; exit(1); } check.
close_reason: Null check already existed; improved error message to include allocation size

title: RC hash set: verify robinhood deletion PSL correctness
description: Open-addressing deletion shifts entries forward but may not recalculate probe sequence length correctly. Verify or fix backward-shift deletion to ensure future lookups don't miss entries.
close_reason: Replaced re-insert deletion with proper backward-shift algorithm that checks home position

title: Recursive release for tuples, closures, and unions
description: emit_rc_release_typed handles Struct and Enum but falls back to plain rc_release for Tuple, Closure, and Union. These types can contain RC fields that leak. Need per-arity release functions for tuples, capture-aware release for closures, and union tag dispatch for unions.

title: Closure capture doesn't check for shadowing
description: find_captures in closures/codegen.fg walks the AST to find variables used from outer scopes, but doesn't track locally-bound names. If a variable in an outer scope is shadowed by a local let/mut inside the closure body, it's still captured incorrectly.

title: Escape analysis catch-all silently ignores new AST nodes
description: remove_escaped_expr and remove_escaped_stmt have _ -> set catch-alls. When new Expr/Stmt variants are added, they won't be analyzed for escapes, potentially causing incorrect release decisions. Should either enumerate all variants explicitly or use a compile-time check.

title: Monomorphizer can't infer Ok type from function return type
description: Functions returning Result<T, E> that only have Err paths need a dead ok_sr_dummy/ok_br_dummy function in an if-false branch to teach the compiler the Ok type. The monomorphizer should infer T from the declared return type annotation instead of needing to see a Result.Ok(T{...}) literal.

title: Generic monomorphizer loses union type
description: Generic monomorphizer loses union type. The monomorphizer infers T from argument types. When a union-typed argument is passed, it should monomorphize T=Union but currently picks the concrete fallback. Workaround: don't pass union values through generics — use concrete union-typed parameters instead.

title: type alias with union syntax not parsed
description: type StringOrInt = int | string fails to parse. The type alias parser expects struct body { fields }, not type expressions. Need to route type alias RHS through parse_type_expr.

title: fix: defer/errdefer must interleave in LIFO declaration order (spec 9.11)
description: Currently defer and errdefer use separate stacks. Spec requires unified LIFO ordering by declaration position. Example: defer A, errdefer B, defer C on error should run C, B, A not B, C, A.

title: typeck: catch body type must match Ok type
description: catch body returns a different type than the Ok value but compiles. Type checker should verify both paths produce the same type. Requires generic Result type resolution in typeck.

title: feat: block mutating method calls on let bindings (spec 11.5)
description: Deep immutability: user.posts.push(p) should error on let bindings. Currently only FieldAssign checked. Needs mut-method tracking.

title: feat: wildcard match warning when hiding >2 variants (spec 8.7)
description: When a wildcard _ hides 3+ enum variants, emit a warning listing the hidden variants. Currently wildcards suppress exhaustiveness check entirely.

title: Fix registry lambda parameter types (int -> proper types)
description: Feature init lambdas use r: int instead of r: Resolver. Requires seed cycle.

notes: Gap: it pronoun only works in method calls (.map(it*2)), not in pipe expressions (|> filter(it>2)). Spec 28.7+28.8 requires both.

description: Code formatter, LSP server, test runner.

title: Release functions: skip emission for non-RC field types
description: emit_struct_field_releases emits release calls for all ptr-typed fields. Should skip fields whose ValueType is a non-RC type (Int stored as ptr due to legacy, etc).
close_reason: Already works: emit_struct_field_releases checks vtype_is_ptr_type before emitting release, skipping Int/Bool/Float

title: RC hash set: increase load factor to 75%
description: runtime.c rc_set uses 50% load factor (used*2 >= capacity) causing frequent resizing. Change to 75% (used*4 >= capacity*3).
close_reason: Changed load factor from 50% to 75% in rc_set_add

title: Separate RC arena from bump arena
description: RC objects and temporary buffers share the same bump arena, distinguished by magic sentinel. Separate arenas would eliminate the magic check overhead in every retain/release call and provide cleaner memory accounting.
close_reason: RC objects now use system malloc, bump arena only used for runtime internals. Separate arenas no longer needed.

title: Single-pass escape analysis
description: Current escape analysis walks the AST twice (collect_owned_bindings + remove_escaped). Could be merged into one pass with careful forward-reference handling. O(2n) -> O(n).
